title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 1: Mixed Figure – Library Visits and Book Loans
prompt: The charts below show the number of visits to a public library and the number of books borrowed from it over a six-month period, and the table shows the percentage of visits made by different age groups in two of those months. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试题。请先仔细阅读图表和表格，找出主要趋势和对比点，然后写一篇至少150词的报告。不要表达个人观点或解释原因。
